title: Searching
definition: Searching retrieves specific elements or values from a collection.
intuition: Locating information efficiently is a fundamental database operation.
how_it_works: Linear scan sequentially or Binary Search by halving search intervals.
when_to_use: Retrieving data or validating membership of elements.
when_not_to_use: When constant-time hash-table lookup is more appropriate.
common_mistakes: Failing to sort array before binary search
